sources.entry: Tarn - A calm menu bar app for focused work rounds and slow breathing, with optional ambient sounds. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/jakeantelis/Tarn) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.one_liner: Tarn is a free, open-source macOS menu bar app that combines Pomodoro-style focus rounds, a slow breathing guide, and optional ambient sounds.
summary.what_it_does: Tarn lives in the Mac menu bar and runs Focus rounds of 15, 25, 45, 60 or 90 minutes, with timed breaks that open a breathing guide. The Focus timer can be shown in a small floating circle that stays above other windows, and rounds and breaks can run on a daily schedule. Breathe mode shows a flower or water picture with four rhythms (Settle, Deep, Box and 4 7 8), optional written prompts, and sessions from 1 to 20 minutes. Sounds include recorded ambient loops (ocean, forest, birds, stream) with presets, a mixer and a fade-out timer. Calm mode goes full screen, plays your last sound mix and hides other apps without quitting them. A tarnctl command-line tool and tarn:// links can start, pause or stop timers and open full screen breathing.
use_cases: run pomodoro work sessions on a mac
guided breathing breaks during the workday
play ambient ocean or forest sounds while working
keep a visible focus timer above other windows
control a mac focus timer from scripts or Raycast
switch to a distraction-free full screen mode
how_to_run: Download Tarn.dmg from the project's releases and open it
Drag Tarn into the Applications folder
Open Tarn and click the flower icon in the menu bar
Optional: in Settings, General, press Install tarnctl to get the command line tool
Build from source: ./build.sh (add run to launch the built app)
stack: Swift (implied by build.sh and macOS app)
notable: Floating frosted circle shows the Focus timer or breathing picture above other windows, draggable and with a sound button
Calm mode combines full screen, last sound mix and hiding other apps, with Esc or click to return
Command-line control via tarnctl and tarn:// links, which can only start/pause/stop timers, hide windows or open full screen breathing
No account, no tracking, and no network use except when Check for updates is pressed
Logic for timer, breathing and sound is kept separate from the interface
caveats: macOS only for now; needs macOS 14 or newer
Must be kept in Applications, as it will not work from the disk image
Tarn never checks for updates by itself; updates require pressing a button
